description.p: G-Desk is a native KDE mail client for Gmail, built on the official Gmail API.
G-Desk est un client mail natif pour KDE qui utilise l'API officielle de Gmail.

ul.li: Folders, categories and labels with unread counts
Dossiers, catégories et libellés avec compteurs de non-lus
Sandboxed HTML reading: no JavaScript, remote images blocked by default
Lecture HTML protégée : pas de JavaScript, images distantes bloquées par défaut
Compose, reply, forward, attachments, drafts and Gmail search
Rédaction, réponse, transfert, pièces jointes, brouillons et recherche Gmail
Google Drive: browse, open, download and upload files, attach Drive files to messages and save attachments to Drive
Google Drive : parcourir, ouvrir, télécharger et importer des fichiers, joindre des fichiers Drive aux messages et enregistrer les pièces jointes dans Drive
Plasma notifications, unread badge and KWallet integration
Notifications Plasma, pastille de non-lus et intégration à KWallet
Light or dark theme, adjustable density and layout, signature
Thème clair ou sombre, densité et disposition réglables, signature

description.p: Unsubscribe from newsletters: G-Desk lists the mailing lists found in received messages with checkboxes and unsubscribes from the checked ones (one-click, by e-mail or through the sender's web page).

New settings: date format in the list (short, numeric, medium, long or relative) and in opened messages, date size, and which folders count towards the unread badge. The Apply button is only enabled when a setting has changed.

Google Drive: a navigation bar on the left switches between mail and Drive (Ctrl+1 / Ctrl+2). Browse My Drive, recent, starred, shared and trashed files, search, open, download, upload (also by drag and drop), create folders, rename, star, trash, and see the storage used.

Attach Drive files to a message (Google Docs, Sheets and Slides are exported to Office formats; a link is offered above 25 MB) and save any attachment to Drive. G-Desk asks once for access to Google Drive.
Fix: the window no longer flashes when the first message is opened in a maximized window.

Performance: the web engine starts only when a message is displayed and is released when the window is hidden; new mail is inserted without reloading the list; fewer and smaller requests to Gmail; lighter drawing of the list and sidebar.
Choose the folder shown at startup (or the last one used), and choose which folders and Gmail categories trigger notifications. Notifications show the category and open the right folder.
Right-click a folder to select all its messages, mark everything as read or unread, or move all its messages to the trash.
Checkboxes on messages with a selection bar: mark read or unread, archive, spam, delete, star or label several messages at once without opening them.
Messages are now shown as cards: sender in bold with the date opposite, subject below and the beginning of the message when there is room.
Redesigned sidebar: compose button, collapsible sections (mail, Gmail categories, more, labels), colored icons, unread badges and account menu.
Color emoji everywhere (list, sidebar, headers, composer), emoji picker in the composer, better decoding of encoded headers and legacy character sets.
Fix: the "preview on the right" layout stayed below the list for users upgrading from 2.0.
New settings window: light/dark theme, list density, preview on the right or below, message text size, sender name, signature, check interval, read marking and privacy options.
Packaging: all runtime dependencies are declared, PNG icons, AppStream metadata and manual page.
